description: AingDesk是一款简单好用的AI助手，支持知识库、模型API、分享、联网搜索、智能体，它还在飞快成长中。 AingDesk is a simple and easy-to-use AI assistant that supports knowledge bases, model APIs, sharing, internet search, and intelligent agents. It is still growing rapidly.
